name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3-pixel solid focus ring with a 3-pixel outer glow in the brand color for all interactive elements. This balances visibility for keyboard users with modern aesthetics—glow adds clarity without overwhelming small touch targets. Trade-off: glow slightly increases render cost on low-end devices, but the benefit to users outweighs the minor performance hit.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 3px ring + 3px glow risks creating a "halo effect" that obscures adjacent content on small screens or when zoomed. Better alternative: Use a 4px solid ring with 20% opacity in the brand color—higher contrast, no glow, no blur. Settle with a live contrast test on a 320px viewport with 200% zoom.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 4px solid ring at 20% opacity in the brand color. It keeps contrast high for keyboard users and avoids the halo risk on small screens or zoom. The trade-off is a slightly softer visual presence for focus, but that’s better than obscuring content.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring at 20% opacity drops contrast below WCAG 2.1 AA for light brand colors on white backgrounds—keyboard users may miss focus. Better: keep the 3px ring but cap glow spread to 2px; settle with a live contrast test on a 320px viewport at 200% zoom and 125% text size.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a 3px solid #0078D4 focus ring with 2px outer glow spread, validated via live contrast test on 320px viewport at 200% zoom and 125% text size—owner: accessibility-w1.
